Collections & Orders

Turn a confirmed commercial handoff into controlled credit, observable collections, receivables evidence and an executable operational order. The lab preserves customer and SPO context internally, keeps risk logic away from the customer-facing experience and hands clean evidence to CAC recovery and Operations while preserving a complete master record for downstream analysis.

01 · INTAKE

Bring the order-to-cash evidence into Collections & Orders i

Load the Sales Orders CSV, SPO customer intelligence, strategic objectives and the Product Page HTML supplied by the user. Load Example loads the embedded teaching package. Collection outcomes are not silently treated as observed facts: any risk, payment or recovery state generated after the handoff is identified as a classroom scenario and remains editable.

What the lab knows now i

SOURCE BOUNDARY

Observed evidence versus teaching scenario i

Observed: customer/order lineage, amount, payment plan requested, customer/SPO context, legal evidence and the upstream handoff state. Simulated: risk outcome, actual collection outcome, overdue reason, manual override and Operations release. This separation keeps the exercise auditable.
DATA RECONCILIATION

Input → processing → output control totals i

These checks protect the lineage of the dataset. A green control means the transformation preserves the input population and monetary value under the current scenario.

02 · CREDIT RISK

Administer the internal SPO credit policy i

This is the credit-policy workbench. Define the maximum number of instalments allowed for each SPO band, compare the customer's requested plan with that ceiling, and record any manual exception. Changes recalculate every affected order immediately.

Step 1Relationship bandRead the internal SPO band from the customer evidence.
Step 2Requested termsRead how many instalments the customer requested.
Step 3Policy ceilingSet the maximum instalments permitted for that SPO band.
Step 4DecisionApprove, require a replan, or identify that no credit is required.
Step 5Human overrideDocument an exception without changing the underlying customer evidence.

Policy matrix. Edit any ceiling below. The workbench updates the full portfolio in real time.

Teaching boundary. The supplied source contains the requested payment plan and SPO context, but not a real external credit-bureau decision. The operator can use this matrix for the exercise; the customer never sees the SPO band, internal score or decision rationale.

03 · COLLECTIONS

Administer cash, credit and recovery status i

The collection workbench translates the credit decision into an operational financial state. The example includes classroom-derived settlement outcomes so the queue is populated immediately, while the original order population and values remain unchanged.

Step 1Risk decisionStart from the approved terms or single-payment requirement.
Step 2Collection eventRecord cash received, approved credit, pending payment or overdue debt.
Step 3Open balanceReconcile collected cash against the order total.
Step 4Recovery actionClassify the reason and route overdue cases to recovery.
Step 5Order releaseRelease only financially eligible orders to Operations.

05 · EXECUTABLE ORDER

Turn released collections into warehouse-ready order labels i

Only financially releasable orders appear here: cash confirmed or credit explicitly approved. Select any order to render its Operations label. The QR carries operational identity only — no SPO score, no internal credit explanation and no unnecessary customer-risk data.

06 · OUTPUT

Six operational deliverables, each with a clear downstream purpose i

The deliverables preserve the full order-to-cash lineage while separating management reporting, customer communication, recovery work and executable Operations evidence. Every export is generated from the same reconciled order population shown in this lab.

PORTFOLIO REPORTING
0

Portfolio Reporting CSV

All management information shown in Section 4: KPIs, target progress, receivables, aging, credit decisions, payment plans, source mix, overdue reasons and strategic-objective context.

CAC · CREDIT COMMUNICATION
0

Credit Decision → CAC CSV

Every order that requested credit, with the approved term or single-payment requirement, a customer-facing rationale that never exposes SPO, and a 5% goodwill offer when the requested credit is not granted.

CAC · RECOVERY
0

Overdue / Unpaid CSV

Only cases requiring recovery action, with customer reference, outstanding balance, reason code, days past due and next action.

0

Order Labels · HTML ZIP

One standalone HTML file per financially released order, including the operational QR and warehouse-ready label content.

METHODOLOGY AT THE END OF THE JOURNEY

DIIIP explains how a confirmed order becomes cash and an executable operation

Collections & Orders creates value when a confirmed order becomes controlled credit, observable cash, recoverable receivables and a clean operational handoff.

D
Data

Confirmed orders, customer keys, requested payment plans, order values, legal evidence, source lineage and SPO context.

I
Information

The order-to-cash record structures credit request, policy ceiling, collection status, amount collected, outstanding balance, reason code and Operations release.

I
Intelligence

SPO-based credit rules plus explicit human override turn customer context into a controlled financing decision without exposing the internal score to the customer.

I
Insights

The portfolio view reveals cash realization, approved credit exposure, overdue concentration, recovery causes and progress against the operating target.

P
Personalization Actions

Collections can replan payment, release the order, route an overdue case to CAC recovery and preserve the full transaction lineage in the master file.
